title: One Tackler rule file (catalog/unblock-rules.d/<id>.json)
description: BH-7722 (UNB-0). One rule per file; a new rule is a new file. The loader (bin/lib/unblock/rules.sh, #7752) refuses two files with one id. Every cite must be a key of _cites.json. Files whose name starts with _ are not rules.

id.description: The rule id, written to unblock_decisions.rule_id.

priority.description: Lower runs first; the first matching rule wins.

family.description: The collector family whose stall records the rule reads (queue, review, infra).

class.description: The staff_classes row the action counts against.

cites.description: Guideline codes; each must be a key of _cites.json.

all.description: jq predicates over the stall record. An error or a null is unknown, and unknown never matches.

when.description: A jq predicate: the judge runs only when it is true.

args.description: Each value is a jq path over the stall record.

key.description: The fields hashed with the rule id into the decision key. No timestamp, no counter.
